native_mechanisms: Fold one crease per mark in strict order, each crease's angle determined by both the mark and the immediately preceding crease (sequential state carry-forward).

Gauge every single crease against all four wire birds' beaks simultaneously, refolding tighter until all four agree before the crease counts as set (per-step four-way consensus, with deliberate anti-alignment scrambling).
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge into one small dense corner and destroy every sheet, trimming and failed reading, keeping only the coin.
core_technique: xxHash/XXH3-style multi-lane block hashing: four parallel 64-bit accumulators absorbing 32-byte blocks via (word^counter-advanced key) 32x32->64 multiply plus lane-rotated adds (AVX2 or scalar), then xxHash64 mergeRound combination and MurmurHash3 fmix64 finalization, with a widened FNV-1a path for short inputs.
